name: PDF Studio
description: A complete PDF workshop: edit, annotate, sign, organise, protect and convert PDFs to Word, Excel, PowerPoint and more — entirely on your own machine.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self'; media-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self' http: https: data: blob:; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'
